author: Acceqted
body:
Hello everyone! You have probably heard about me and are wondering why I'm no longer on a team. I personally do not want to display that information, and if is bugging you so much you can PM me, but moving on.

I'm looking for a competitive team that has done well either in tournaments or scrims. I would be happy to trial for teams to!

Position: Support (Expander on bridges)
Looking for: A competitive team serious and has good communication.


Open to any team!
